text_block_list.text: One day, as the end of summer training camp drew near—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
S-So you're saying... you're giving up
on challenging the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"For today's Sapporo Kinen...
I had set a personal goal for myself, but...
I fell short of reaching it."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'd decided from the very start.
If I couldn't achieve my goal,
I'd give up on traveling abroad.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So starting this autumn,
I plan to run in domestic races!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: In that case, will the next race she enters be... the Shuka Sho!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I want to aim for the Triple Tiara and give it everything I've got...!
(Oooooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
There are many voices among the fans hoping
to see you run in the Arima Kinen, but――

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course, if that is what everyone wishes for,
I would love to run in the Arima Kinen as well.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: There's someone I'd like to try running with, so—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
My word...! Might I ask,
who exactly is this person...!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —It's Dream Journey!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen the other day
was so moving to watch...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to move everyone's hearts
just like that, too...!
"—This press conference by Buena Vista instantly became a hot topic among race fans."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text:
"Wait...! A clash between Buena-chan
and Lady Journey at the Arima Kinen is
looking crazy likely, this is insane...!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Site
text_block_list.text: "『The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was a bummer, and we still have the Shuka Sho, but that's one more thing to look forward to at the end of the year! I'm super hyped to see Buena Vista in action!』"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
It's still trending on social media, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Should we expect anything less from Buena-san?
choice_data_list: Looks like things worked out in all sorts of ways.
Looks like things worked out in all sorts of ways.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh my...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...She's talking as if I did something wrong.
choice_data_list: That's because you won the Takarazuka Kinen, isn't it?
Isn't that because you won the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Haha――
That's right.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It must be the result of your everyday good deeds.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I simply cannot wait.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
After all, the "storm" has gone out of its way
to turn its gaze toward us.

And...
the "journey" heads toward a converging autumn—
